root_process_resolution.preferred: Explicit -RootProcessId from A-3 target-PC readback receipt
root_process_resolution.fallback: Auto-detect only when exactly one top-level YOLLA/electron candidate exists

scenarios.precondition: YOLLA panel is running and all ChatGPT browser seats are closed or inactive according to the current runtime UI.
scenarios.measurement: Capture at least 30 one-second process-tree samples.

scenarios.precondition: Panel is running with no active ChatGPT browser before the action.
scenarios.action: Use an existing runtime control action to open or activate exactly one ChatGPT browser; do not create a new browser engine.
scenarios.measurement: Record action elapsed time and at least 30 post-action samples.

scenarios.precondition: One ChatGPT browser seat is active.
scenarios.action: Switch the active seat to inactive using existing runtime controls.
scenarios.measurement: Record transition elapsed time and at least 30 post-transition samples.

scenarios.precondition: Exactly one ChatGPT browser is active.
scenarios.action: Close the active browser through the existing runtime lifecycle path.
scenarios.measurement: Record close elapsed time and at least 30 post-close samples, including renderer/GPU/utility counts.

scenarios.precondition: The previously active ChatGPT browser is closed.
scenarios.action: Reopen the browser through the existing runtime lifecycle path.
scenarios.measurement: Record reopen elapsed time and at least 30 post-reopen samples.

scenarios.precondition: A BROWSER_CLOSE receipt and BROWSER_REOPEN receipt exist for the same target runtime authority and machine session.
scenarios.measurement: Treat the paired close/reopen receipts as the composite scenario; compare first/last memory and process deltas without promoting static results to live PASS.
